Hotel Sales & Representation

Hotel Representation Agency Models in India

Choose a sales desk for regular account follow-up, a fractional lead for commercial planning, or a specialist trade agency when leisure distribution is the gap.

Discuss your project

Choose the operating model

An outsourced sales desk can take regular meetings and proposal follow-up, while a fractional lead may own planning and oversee your existing staff. A specialist trade agency is a narrower fit when your main gap is leisure distribution.

Test the handover

Ask who updates the account history, what happens to open opportunities at the end of a contract, and how a buyer enquiry reaches reservations.
